title: SideCode
description: OpenCode but Cursor style — VS Code sidebar client for OpenCode sessions.

title: PDB Viewer & Protein Structure
description: PDB viewer for VS Code: open PDB, mmCIF, SDF, MOL2, XYZ, GRO and PQR files as a 3D protein or molecule model with cartoon, sticks, spheres and surface, a chain and ligand tree, a sequence strip and atom details. Works over Remote SSH and WSL. Offline, no account.

title: D2 Diagram Viewer & D2 Preview
description: D2 diagram viewer for VS Code: a live D2 preview beside the text that redraws as you type, with pan, zoom, D2 themes, error squiggles and click-to-line. The D2 engine is bundled (WebAssembly), so no D2 install and no network.

title: XSD Viewer & Schema Diagram
description: XSD viewer for VS Code: open XML Schema (.xsd) files and the schemas in .wsdl files as a tree and a diagram, with imports and includes resolved across the workspace, search and jump to line. Offline, no account.

title: VBA Viewer & Macro Extractor
description: VBA viewer for VS Code: open the macros inside .xlsm, .xlsb, .xls, .docm, .doc, .pptm, .ppt and vbaProject.bin files without Office, with every module, its source in color, search and module details. Read-only; no macro runs.

title: OpenSCAD Viewer & 3D Preview
description: OpenSCAD 3D preview beside your .scad code: orbit, pan, zoom, grid, print bed and wireframe, re-rendered on save. Echo, warnings and errors with clickable lines, syntax colors and an outline. Uses your installed OpenSCAD.

title: ResX Editor & RESX Viewer
description: ResX Editor & RESX Viewer for VS Code: open .resx and .resw files as a grid of name, value and comment. Add, rename, filter and sort entries, and save the same XML with the schema header, the order and the comments kept. Offline, no account, no .NET install.

title: Incremental Editing Engine
description: Edit code one function at a time with an LLM. Only the code that changes is sent to the model, and you review every diff.

title: XMind Preview
description: XMind mind map editor for VS Code

title: AI Code Verifier
description: Verify AI-generated code before you merge it: static logic analysis, spec-vs-implementation comparison, critical test generation and a merge confidence score.

title: sb-i.jp Learning System

title: Git Blame Another Lens
